gtfsIdentity.currentPassengerAccessReview: Current Hotel JAL City Nagasaki access page explicitly names both Nagasaki Bus Airportliner and Nagasaki Keneibus airport limousine and currently links its own airport-bus boarding/alighting pedestrian guide. The guide marks airport-bus alighting at NTT Nagasaki and airport-bound boarding at Nagasaki Bus Terminal Hotel. Its directed public-street pedestrian arrows connect the alighting frontage east to the marked street crossing, south along the Chinatown river-side public street, west along the hotel-front public street, then north along the Chinatown street and east to the boarding frontage. The selected relation follows these drawn public-street portions continuously; it does not enter either hotel, reserve a room, use a guest-only facility, cross between poles by proximity, or infer a shortcut. Current Keneibus native page identifies named Shinchi Chinatown pole5 as alighting-only and pole1 as boarding-only for the Dejima airport route. Exact retained GTFS881740_05 and881740_01 have those same distinct roles and route20 records; suffixes alone are not a global alias rule. Terminal Hotel current own page corroborates arrival frontage, departure at its entrance, and public ticket/waiting access for non-guests; the selected walk does not require its interior. The linked map filename dates20210601 and no2026 map edition is claimed: current publication and exact current producer stop roles provide continuity. No route geometry, distance, clocks, accessibility, opening-hours or raw-map reuse is claimed.

rightsReview.reason: Hotel own currently published access guide, not an airline timetable or a licensed third-party map, supports one independently structured public-street relation. Its page/PDF display general copyright; linked rules are accommodation/banquet terms and confer no raw reuse license. No express independent nonexpressive topology-analysis prohibition was found in these inspected materials. Terminal Hotel linked terms are accommodation terms, not a data license. Keneibus actual site terms reserve expressive content and restrict unauthorized copying/reuse except legally permitted uses; only minimum stop-role corroboration is retained. No artwork, mapped geometry, prose, clock table or raw PDF is redistributed. This is the existing minimum-fact scope, not permission to republish raw content. Existing CC BY4 applies only to the already admitted GTFS identities/services.
